Experimental study on Biogas Production 
through Anaerobic Digestion of Wheat Straw 
and Urban Fallen Leaves
Yahong Liang, Hua Zhang, Guanlin Mou 
School of Environment and Municipal Engineering 
Xi'an University of Architecture & Technology 
Xi'an, 710055, China 
lyah@xauat.edu.cn, 106016305@qq.com, 442531053@qq.com 
Abstract˖In this experiment, wheat straw and fallen leaves were used as the raw materials for solid-state anaerobic 
digestion (SS-AD). Straw, leaves and mixture of them were aerobic pretreated respectively. When the pretreated 
composting temperature raised to 313-328K, the raw materials were added to the test device and for SS-AD 
respectively. The comparison of the experiment results show that: the volatile solids (VS) gas production of the straw 
is higher than that of the fallen leaves. The fermentative materials of leaves have the most accumulation and the 
longest retention time of gas production. When the raw materials of straw and leaves at a ratio of 2:1 in the test of SS-
AD,  the biogas production will be increased. 
Keywords˖wheat straw; fallen leaves; pretreatment; solid-state anaerobic digestion
I.
INTRODUCTION
With the development of economy in the rural areas 
of China, people's living standard improved constantly 
and the consumption of traditional fossil energy 
increased quickly. Due to China's large population, if the 
countryside has the same way of energy consumption as 
the city, it will cause big energy problems. The biomass 
resources is abundant in the rural areas of China, 
agricultural straw accounts for 70% above of the whole 
biomass. According to the relevant statistic in 2008, 71 
million tons of agricultural straw was produced in the 
whole country [1], but the utilization ratio is lower than 
30%. Most of them are incinerated directly in field, the 
environment is polluted and a lot of biomass resources 
are wasted. In the urban of China, the green coverage is 
demanded to be 48%. With the ascension of green 
coverage, 
the 
fallen 
leaves 
increased 
and 
the 
environment pollution problem caused by leaves 
becomes more and more serious.  Therefore, it is 
important to use the biomass in rural areas and fallen 
leaves in urban city effectively [2]. This paper mainly 
discusses the energy utilization of wheat straw and fallen 
leaves in urban, and the regulation of gas production in 
the test of biological pretreatment and solid-state 
anaerobic digestion (SS-AD) is also discussed. 
II.
EXPERIMENTAL MATERIALS
AND METHODS
A. Raw Materials and Composition 
Determination  
Wheat straw and fallen leaves were collected in the 
suburb of Xi'an City and the campus of Xi'an University 
of Architecture and Technology respectively, the 
inoculums sludge was collected from the return sludge 
pump room of the fourth effluent treatment plant in 
Shannxi Province. The total solids (TS) content  was 
measured in a drying stove at the temperature of 
378±5K,  the volatile  solids (VS) content was measured 
in a muffle furnace at the temperature of 823±10K. The 
relevant parameters of carbon, nitrogen, cellulose, 
hemicellulose and lignin content were referred to the 
bibliography [3~5]. The composition of each raw 
material is shown in Table.I.

B.   Experimental Equipments and Methods 
1) Pretreatment device and methods: the storage box 
at the size of 530×370×370mm3 was used as 
pretreatment device.  the raw materials were shredded at 
3-5cm in the box and then modifier (303-313 K warm 
water)  was added to wet for 24 h. After wetting, the 
modifier was added sequentially, and the moisture of the 
fermentation materials reach to 70%. It can be observed 
in Table.I that the ratio of C/N between straw and leaves 
deviate required range (20-30:1) of actual anaerobic 
digestion. In this experiment, we adjusted the ratio of 
C/N by adding the urea. Meanwhile, the raw materials 
were pretreated by adding bacterial agent (BM cellulose 
utilization microorganisms) with the ratio of 1/200. 
According to the temperature rise of windrow (the

temperature rises to 313-328K), the pretreatment time 
was 2-4 days in summer and 7 days in winter. When the 
temperature of raw materials rose to 313-328K, the 
pretreatment stage was completed, the pretreated raw 
materials were placed into the anaerobic fermentation 
device to stand-by.  
2) SS-AD device and methods: The test of device is 
shown in Fig.1, two jars with the volume of 2500mL 
(2000mL effective volume) were adopted as the 
fermentation device and the drainage set gas device 
respectively, the measuring cylinder with the volume of 
1000mL was used as the catchment metering device, 
these three containers composed the gas connected test 
device. The rubber tube and the glass tube, rubber 
stoppers and the bottle junction of the experiment device 
were sealed with paraffin. The gas was collected 
according to the law of drainage set gas. Before the SS-
AD test , the air tightness of the device should be 
checked. In the SS-AD test, we added 30-40% 
inoculated sludge to the pretreatment raw materials and 
regulated the TS content reach 15-30%, then placed it 
into device for the SS-AD test. Comparing the VS gas 
production of raw materials (wheat straw, leaves) at 
different ambient temperature, the proper SS-AD 
condition was obtained. The test period is from July to 
December in 2011, the change of water in the cylinder 
was measured and the rate of gas production was 
calculated. The gas composition was analyzed using gas 
chromatography of Agilent 6890N.

III. EXPERIMENTAL RESULTS AND
ANALYSIS 
A. Results and Analysis in Pretreatment Stage 

Change of temperature in the windrow during 
the bio-pretreatment process  
With 
the 
process 
of 
bio-pretreatment, 
the 
temperature of windrow is rising, but after a certain 
reaction time, the temperature decreased gradually. The 
change of temperature inside the windrow was shown in 
Fig.2. Because the raw materials was pre-wetted before 
the pretreatment, the temperature in the windrow raised 
quickly. After pretreated for 4 days, the windrow 
reached the highest temperature of 326K. The 
temperature in the windrow was above 313K for7 days 
before pretreating. After pretreated for 8 days, with the 
SS-AD 
test 
loading 
process, 
the 
stir 
intensity 
strengthened, the heat released from the windrow 
increased gradually, the temperature in the windrow 
dropped quickly until the same as the indoor temperature. 
In this experiment, the raw materials of the SS-AD test 
were selected at the pretreatment time of 4 days and 7 
days respectively.

Influence of  gas production on the bio-
pretreatment time and the raw materials 
 The pretreatment time was different, the cumulative 
gas production in the SS-AD process was also different. 
The  pretreatment time for  4 days (feed temperature was 
326K) and 8 days (feed temperature was 301K), the 
cumulative gas production was shown in Fig.3. The 
lignin and the waxy layer of the wheat straw were not 
destroyed completely after the shorter pretreatment time 
of 4 days, but at this time the windrow reached the 
highest temperature of 326K. With the temperature of 
326K windrow to loading for the SS-AD,  the anaerobic 
digestion 
with 
high 
start-up 
temperature, 
the 
thermophilic and anaerobic bacterium made the raw 
material degradation rapidly, the raw materials can 
produce gas normally. The gas production was 280mL 
initially, the duration of gas production was 28 days, 
when the cumulative gas production reached 6400mL, 
the gas production finished. after pretreated for 8 days, 
the temperature in the windrow  declined to 301 K, 
loading the raw material. The pretreatment time is longer, 
the lignin and waxy layer is further damaged and broken 
down, but the organic matter in the straw also degraded 
rapidly. At the beginning of SS-AD, the initial gas 
production was 460mL, after the cumulative gas 
production reached to 3332mL, the gas production 
duration was 13 days, the raw materials of fermentation 
stop producing gas due to the lack of organic matter. 
Therefore, when pretreated for 4 days and the raw 
materials temperature reached to 326K, loading the raw 
materials can obtain the most cumulative gas production 
and the longest gas production time. It implied that the 
reasonable pretreatment time and the temperature of raw 
materials have great influence on gas production. 
Increasing  the raw materials temperature of the SS-AD 
appropriately will increase the biogas yield.  
B. Results and Analysis about the Process of 
SS-AD

Influence of ambient temperature on the biogas 
production  
  In this SS-AD experiment, the reaction equipment 
was placed in room, the ambient temperature would 
affect the gas production of SS-AD directly. The change 
of biogas production with ambient temperature as shown 
in Fig.4. When the ambient temperature rises, the gas 
production of SS-AD process also increased gradually. 
When the ambient temperature reached to 305.5K, the 
biogas quantity was 710mL, when the ambient 
temperature dropped to 292K,  the biogas quantity was 
only 30ml. When the ambient temperature changed 
moderately, the change range of biogas production was  
not too much. When the ambient temperature changed 
above 278K, the gas production changed obviously, and 
sometimes even stop producing gas. However, when the 
ambient temperature raised again, the gas production 
rebounded. It can be seen that the change of ambient

 Influence of different raw materials on biogas 
yield

The gas yield of SS-AD process is different when 
using different biomass materials. Selecting appropriate 
materials is the most important for biogas yield. In this 
experiment, we selected three materials, straw, leaves 
and mixture of them (mixed at a ratio of 2:1) for contrast. 
The cumulative biogas yield of each material in the SS-
AD process was shown in Fig.5. The parameters of each 
material were shown in Table II. The methane content of 
biogas was above 50% when the reaction at the third day 
with different ratio of raw materials for SS-AD.

As shown in Fig.5 and Table II, the gas production of 
wheat was the highest, so is the average daily gas 
production. The accumulative gas production leaves was 
the highest and the gas production duration is the longest. 
Leaves and wheat straw co-digestion of raw materials 
accumulation gas production more than mono-digestion 
of leaves 1956mL, and the daily gas production is higher 
than 0.06L/kg•d, gas production of  unit volume was 
higher than mono-digestion wheat straw 0.98L/L.   
The reason is that cellulose and hemicellulose in the 
leaves (11.1%, 11.5% ) is lower than wheat straw 
(30.5%, 23.5%), while the lignin content of leaves is 
22.7% and that of the wheat straw is 18.0% (see Table.1). 
The studies of Lo Niee Liew [6] have shown that the 
biogas production ability of raw materials is directly 
influenced by the degradation extent of cellulose and 
hemicellulose. For the raw materials,  the content of 
cellulose and hemicellulose is higher, the degradation 
ability of raw materials is stronger during the 
pretreatment process, the gas production will increase. 
The VS gas production of wheat straw with higher 
content of cellulose and hemicellulose  is higher than 
that of leaves.  
However, after shredded the wheat straw and leaves, 
leaves have higher packing density than wheat straw, 
when loading the materials, the per unit volume of 
leaves was 0.91kg more than  0.53kg of wheat straw, 
and the leaves have the most accumulative gas 
production. Besides, the studies of Deepak Singh [7] 
have shown that the lignin in the plant cell wall 
connection with cellulose and hemicellulose to provide 
plant has integrate structural. It can account for higher 
content of lignin, the slower degradation rate of raw 
materials. In the pretreatment process broken the lignin 
in the cell wall can facilitate degradation of cellulose and 
hemicellulose, increase the gas production. Because of 
the higher lignin content in the leaves, the degradation 
rate in pretreatment time is lower, making the leaves 
have longer time of gas production in SS-AD process 
and more accumulative gas production. Co-digestion of 
leaves and wheat straw, because of the particular 
structure in the leaves, the per unit volume gas 
production of raw materials was higher than mono-
digestion wheat straw, daily gas production was higher 
than mono-digestion of leaves. Therefore, according to 
the actual situation, adding the leaves as the raw 
materials in the SS-AD process, will not only extend the 
SS-AD time, but also increase the biogas production.

IV.
CONCLUSIONS 
1)
The experiment results show that pretreating 
the raw materials with physical grinding and biological 
agent, can effectively broke down the lignin and waxy 
layer of biomass  straw . Besides, it can also increase 
the contact area of cellulose and hemicellulose, and 
increase the degradation of organic matter to improve 
biogas production. It can increase the biogas production 
effectively when dry fermentation directly with the 
pretreatment temperature at 326K. It indicates that the 
reasonable 
pretreatment 
temperature 
has 
great  
influence on accumulative gas production.

2)
Ambient temperature is the important factor 
for the SS-AD process. When the ambient temperature 
reaches above 303 K, the biogas production will 
improve effectively. For  the actual operation of the SS-
AD process, increasing the ambient temperature can 
increase the accumulative biogas production.   
3)
Compared with wheat straw and fallen leaves, 
as the cellulose and hemicellulose of wheat straw is 
higher than that of leaves, the mono-digestion of straw's 
VS gas production is higher than that of leaves, which is 
67.53L/kg•VS. However, due to the packing density in 
the leaves is higher and per unit volume loading the raw 
materials is larger, the leaves have the most 
accumulative gas production and the longest production 
time. 
4)
In the wheat straw's SS-AD process, adding 
leaves as the raw materials appropriately not only can 
increase the accumulative biogas production, but also 
extend reaction time of SS-AD process. Meanwhile, it 
can effectively use urban leaves and solve the 
environmental problems in urban areas.
